Overview

Juiz de Fora is a city in MG with a population of 577,532. A historic city in Minas Gerais’ Zona da Mata region, known for its university, cultural scene, and mountain-surrounded landscape. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
